title: $\otimes^{\mathrm L}$ preserves bounded constructible complexes ($\ell$-adic $\Lambda$)
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be one of $\underline{\cO}_E$, $\underline E$ ($E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite;
[sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]) or $\underline{\Qlb}$ ([sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed]), and let $X$
be a scheme of the setting of [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. If $K,L\in D(\Mod_{\Lambda_X})$ are bounded
constructible ([sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible]), then so is
$K\otimes^{\mathrm L}_{\Lambda_X}L$ ([sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom]).

external.place: For $K$ and $L$ bounded constructible it is derived $\varpi$-complete (Bhatt–Scholze, §6.8), and its reduction is $$ (K\otimes^{\mathrm L}L)/\varpi\cong(K/\varpi)\otimes^{\mathrm L}_{\cO_E/\varpi}(L/\varpi). $$ This is a derived tensor product of bounded constructible étale complexes over the field $\cO_E/\varpi$, hence bounded with constructible cohomology.

For $K$ and $L$ bounded constructible it is derived $\varpi$-complete (Bhatt–Scholze, §6.8), and its reduction is $$ (K\otimes^{\mathrm L}L)/\varpi\cong(K/\varpi)\otimes^{\mathrm L}_{\cO_E/\varpi}(L/\varpi). $$ This is a derived tensor product of bounded constructible étale complexes over the field $\cO_E/\varpi$, hence bounded with constructible cohomology.

proof.text: Apply the two-truncation-induction tensor-closure theorem. Its base case is exactly the degree-zero local calculation of the original proof; its target triangulation comes directly from the proved constructible Serre theorems. The independent coefficient-unit calculation supplies the unit part when packaging this as the monoidal restricted-functor instance.
